recovery.scope: Restore original scoped arrays, test/token records and cursor integers in ten card handlers, removing nine merged source unions. Native literal array geometry, emitted extents, disjoint code lifetimes for overlapping frame storage, eleven test parameter event sets with exact callback relocation identities, four token constant-store sets/initializer IDs and consumer pointers are checked. Merrow and Clone Shell restore100-byte literal-initialized message arrays including their complete zero padding; Clone Shell also restores two one-IID display arrays. Gustha Scepter cursor pointer pairs bind actual signed32 leg/idx locals. Source replay preserves every other byte, including counts, callback/matrix operands, costs, original native quirks, labels and branches. Kaya retains its original priority[6] declaration and write expressions even if the rebuilt compiler removes that now-dead source array; no volatile allocation is invented. Scalar copies feeding dialog weights are unchanged. Only fixed literal bounds are credited. Dynamic append-format values, actual selected indices, arbitrary aliases, full function behavior and gameplay remain outside these bounded checks. Historical receipts and historical compiled-union artifacts stay immutable; current legacy tests bind the actual scoped records through exact source supersession. Unknown REP STOSD counts remain unknown in the effect tool. Native Kaya Guile additionally proves two omitted token writes: key_plus32 (flying) and color_forced34 (black/white), both now restored. Rebuilt Windgrace initializer/generator and Reign dialog pointer spills remain unknown to the conservative call-memory model; exact typed source operands, actual local geometry and native/source scalar-store evidence are retained, and those unknown binary operands are not credited as definite frame pointers.

arrays.scope: Read-only geometry/name follow-up on59 old array flags. Explicit source-verified canonical helper names account for renamed functions and outlined helper bodies. Literal dimensions, element widths/kinds and emitted fixed-frame locations are compared. These are declaration/geometry classifications, not full-function or array-content equivalence proofs; unmatched aggregates, compiler inline scopes and spelling aliases still require review.

tokens.scope: Read-only token-local inventory, not a missing-write or behavior verdict. Recognizes exact76-byte token member geometry and zero-offset token views in current unions. Includes outer C function locals and compiler self-inline copies; other helper-inline scopes and C++ units are excluded. Fixed DW_OP_fbreg declarations are inventoried separately from unlocated/nonfixed variables. Function-owner pairing uses native RVAs and the existing comparison CSV; cloned/split/outlined cases need separate resolution. Next work must compare initializer-to-generation scalar writes and callback identities, with lexical/CFG scope filtering to avoid attributing another reused local to a token.
